_doc: Equipment lines: multipliers on top of a component's family and tier base (docs/CONTENT.md section 2). cost: crafting cost. power: power draw (a consumer's negative power is scaled by it). output: the family's main stat (thrust, power produced, O2 rate). mass: mass of the part. heat: heat gained while running. repair: repair time. malfunction_per_min: chance per minute that a running part malfunctions. ion_vulnerability: damage from ion hits. A component picks its line with the `line` field; an unknown line counts as standard.
